correctness.rationale: The ternary-relational group structure (Z/pZ,0,R(x,y,z) iff x+y=z), quantifier rank exactly 3, unrestricted Boolean branching and zero constant are essential. The nested atomic-extension type recursion characterizes all rank-3 sentences, including repeated selected variables. For first nonzero x normalize x=1 by scaling; at third move 12 affine special z values exhaust nongeneric atomic extensions (with a generic remaining diagram). Their 66 pairwise coincidence equations have exactly the 13 rational slopes S={-2,-1,-1/2,0,1/4,1/3,1/2,2/3,1,3/2,2,3,4}; cross-difference bound 15 makes them pairwise distinct mod p>=17. Thus all p>=17 realize an identical extension spectrum, including zero first picks. Five characteristic-isolating rank<=3 sentences isolate p=2,3,5,7,11; the two existential branches in the rank-3 Phi_11 force y=3x and 4y=x, hence 11x=0, and Gamma distinguishes p=13 from all >=17. This gives exactly seven classes without extrapolating finite data. Independently recomputed complete rank-3 atomic Hintikka signatures on primes 2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23: the six small primes separate and 17,19,23 coincide. Assumption of relational—not functional—addition prevents illicit low-rank terms.
